description: This file defines the XmlErrorParser class, which parses XML error responses from AWS services, extracting error codes, messages, and request IDs.

classes.name: XmlErrorParser
classes.description: A class that parses XML error responses from AWS APIs, extracting error details and handling namespace registration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with optional Service and XmlParser instances.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method to parse the response and extract error information.

methods.name: parseHeaders
methods.description: Parses headers to extract error code and request ID.

methods.name: parseBody
methods.description: Parses the XML body to extract error code, message, and request ID.

methods.name: registerNamespacePrefix
methods.description: Registers namespace prefix for XPath queries based on XML namespaces.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Parses the XML payload to extract error details using the parser.
